messages.summary:
## Objective
- Criar um jogo completo e jogável, baseado em texto e escolhas, inspirado no BitLife e ambientado no mundo de Naruto.

## Requirements
- Interface em português; muitas atividades e escolhas ao longo da vida do personagem.
- Não fazer perguntas de esclarecimento; adotar suposições razoáveis.
- O usuário pediu capturas de verificação em JPEG pequeno, com viewport de até 1280 px, lendo apenas a captura mais recente.

## Decisions
- Implementação autocontida em HTML, CSS e JavaScript, sem dependências.
- Jornada começa aos 6 anos, inclui clã, vila, atividades, atributos, relações, eventos anuais, diário e salvamento automático no navegador.

## Work State
### Completed
- Criado `index.html` com a tela inicial e jogo responsivo em português.
- Implementados eventos por fase da vida, escolhas com consequências, seis atividades, atributos e relações, diário, progressão de idade, fim da jornada e salvamento/retomada com `localStorage`.
- Corrigido erro de sintaxe nos templates JavaScript; `node --check /tmp/game.js` passou sem erros.

### Active
- Verificar o jogo num navegador, corrigir possíveis problemas funcionais/visuais e criar a captura JPEG solicitada.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Abrir `http://localhost:3002` com `playwright-cli` e testar iniciar uma vida, atividades, escolhas e retomada do salvamento.
2. Corrigir eventuais problemas encontrados e salvar/inspecionar uma captura JPEG recente com viewport de até 1280 px.
3. Resumir a implementação e as suposições ao concluir.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: implementação integral do jogo.

## Important Context
- Servidor iniciado via `python3 -m http.server 3002` e deixado rodando.
- Alterações ainda não foram commitadas.
- O jogo usa `skillLabel()` e `render()` no script inline de `index.html`; sintaxe verificada após as últimas alterações.

## Objective
- Criar um jogo completo de escolhas, baseado em texto e inspirado no BitLife, ambientado no mundo de Naruto.

## Requirements
- Interface em português, com muitas atividades e escolhas ao longo da vida do personagem.
- Não fazer perguntas de esclarecimento; adotar suposições razoáveis.
- Verificar o jogo em captura JPEG pequena, com viewport de até 1280 px, lendo apenas a captura mais recente.

## Decisions
- Implementação autocontida em HTML, CSS e JavaScript, sem dependências.
- Jornada começa aos 6 anos e inclui clã, vila, eventos, atividades, atributos, relações, diário e salvamento no navegador.

## Work State
### Completed
- Criado `index.html` com interface responsiva em português, progressão da vida ninja, escolhas com consequências, seis atividades, relações, diário, fim de jornada e salvamento/retomada via `localStorage`.

- Testado no navegador: iniciar personagem Ren do clã Uchiha, treinar, tomar uma decisão, recarregar e retomar a jornada salva.
- Inspecionada a captura JPEG `screenshots/shinobi-check.jpg`, feita em viewport de 1280 px.

### Active
- Verificar a sintaxe e o jogo novamente após a última alteração de escape de conteúdo HTML.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rodar `node --check` no script extraído de `index.html`.
2. Fazer uma verificação rápida no navegador e atualizar/inspecionar a captura JPEG mais recente, se necessário.
3. Resumir a implementação e as suposições ao concluir.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: implementação integral do jogo.
- `screenshots/shinobi-check.jpg`: captura JPEG de verificação atual.

## Important Context
- Servidor de desenvolvimento foi iniciado em `http://localhost:3002`.
- Alterações ainda não foram commitadas.

- Mostrar a data atual do mundo de Naruto durante a vida do personagem.

## Decisions
- Usar um calendário de anos fictício derivado da idade do personagem, começando no ano 66 aos 6 anos.
- Inserir eventos canônicos associados a anos específicos; o massacre Uchiha oferece opções especiais a personagens Uchiha de Konohagakure.
- Implementar combate por turnos com ataque, jutsu, defesa e fuga.

## Objective
- Corrigir a inicialização da jornada e expandir o jogo com escolha de era inicial e vantagens de combate por clã.

## Requirements
- A jornada deve iniciar normalmente e preservar calendário, combate, caminho rogue e eventos canônicos.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the existing shinobi game so era selection is reflected in the displayed era and world year, characters can be interacted with individually when they exist in the timeline, and players can have children and continue the journey as them.

## Requirements
- Selecting an era, such as Madara and Hashirama’s, should update the displayed era and world year.
- Characters should only be available for individual interaction when they exist in the selected timeline; characters from later eras become available when the world reaches their era.
- Allow the player to have children and continue playing as them without starting a new, unrelated journey.

## Decisions
- The existing game uses `state.worldYear` as its timeline and stores the selected era in `state.era`.
- Earlier work established the default era as Naruto and Sasuke, with alternate starts for Hagoromo and Madara/Hashirama.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial era selection, era-specific start years and events, and clan combat traits in `index.html`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and tested starting in all three eras in Chromium.

### Active
- Implement dynamic era/timeline display and ensure the selected era sets the appropriate world year.
- Add individual character interaction with timeline-based availability.
- Add children and a way to continue the game as a child while retaining family/journey continuity.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `index.html` to implement the three requested features, building on the existing `state.era`, `state.worldYear`, and `state.relations` structures.
2. Test era changes and world-year progression, character availability/interactions, and the parent-to-child continuation flow.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, era/timeline state, character relations, events, and save/load behavior.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were reported as untracked in Git.
- Current era options and start years are `hagoromo: -1000`, `hashirama: 0`, and `naruto: 66`; the era label is displayed in the game header.
- Existing characters are stored in `state.relations`, but there is no individual interaction flow or family/child succession system yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the Shinobi game so the selected era and world year are reflected in play, characters become available when they enter the timeline, and players can interact with them individually.
- Allow players to have children and continue the family’s journey as a child without starting an unrelated new life.

## Requirements
- Selecting an era, such as Madara and Hashirama’s, should update the displayed era and world year.
- Characters should only be available for individual interaction when they exist in the selected timeline; later-era characters become available as the world reaches their era.
- Players should be able to have children and continue playing as them while preserving family and journey continuity.

## Decisions
- `state.worldYear` is the timeline; `state.era` stores the selected starting era.
- Existing era start years are Hagoromo `-1000`, Madara/Hashirama `0`, and Naruto/Sasuke `66`.
- Children can take over the journey at age 16; the family journey state is retained.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing initial era selection, era-specific start years/events, and clan combat traits were added in earlier work.
- Added a character timeline catalog, availability synchronization, child/family state initialization, and functions for character interactions, family creation, and succession in `index.html`.
- Updated timeline event selection to use the current world year’s era and added a succession option to the ending screen.

### Active
- Wire the new character interaction and child/family controls into the rendered UI.
- Ensure the displayed era label reflects the current world year, not only the selected starting era.
- Test era starts and progression, character availability and interactions, and parent-to-child succession; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `index.html` rendering to display currently available characters with individual interaction controls and actions to form a family.
2. Make the era badge reflect the timeline’s current era as `worldYear` advances.
3. Exercise the game flows and verify save/resume behavior, including family succession.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, era and world-year state, timeline events, character relations, family/succession logic, and save/load behavior.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were reported as untracked in Git.
- The latest edits added `characterTimeline`, `timelineEra`, `availableCharacters`, `syncCharacters`, `interactWith`, `relationshipAction`, `childAge`, and `continueAsChild`.
- The new interaction functions are not yet connected to the relationship panel UI.
- The era badge still uses `state.era`, so it will not update to later eras as the world year advances.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Desenvolver o jogo Shinobi em `index.html` para que a linha do tempo, as interações com personagens e a sucessão familiar funcionem em conjunto.
- Ampliar a seção de registros para mostrar mudanças de estatísticas, relações e acontecimentos do mundo, e incluir mais personagens vivos em cada era.

## Requirements
- A era escolhida define o ano inicial; personagens só ficam disponíveis enquanto presentes na linha do tempo.
- Permitir interações individuais e formação de família; sucessão aos 16 anos preserva a jornada, o ano, as memórias e a linhagem.
- Expandir o registro para incluir aumentos de estatísticas e vínculos, além de acontecimentos do mundo Shinobi; considerar um nome mais adequado que “Memórias recentes”.
- Adicionar personagens de cada era; na era Naruto, incluir Kiba, Ino e Shikamaru, além de outros personagens vivos nas demais épocas.

## Decisions
- `state.worldYear` é a linha do tempo; `state.era` guarda a era inicial escolhida.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e37a579f9ffefrUgziFi9T8ps0" state="completed">
## Resumo

A lógica está concentrada em **`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`**. Há atributos e bônus de clã que já afetam o combate, mas **não encontrei um sistema de afinidades nem um catálogo de técnicas desbloqueáveis por inteligência**. Hoje, “usar jutsu” é uma ação genérica de combate.

## Pontos relevantes

- **Linhas 16–26 — `clanTraits`**: define bônus de clã para dano, custo e recuperação de chakra, defesa e esquiva. É o ponto existente mais próximo de uma tabela de habilidades especiais.
- **Linha 38 — `startGame()`**: inicializa os atributos (`chakra`, `taijutsu`, `ninjutsu`, `intel`) e concede bônus iniciais a alguns clãs.
- **Linhas 76–81 — ações de atividade**: incluem treino, estudo e missões. Estudar aumenta `intel`; a missão usa a soma de `intel`, `taijutsu`, `ninjutsu` e `chakra` para determinar o sucesso.
- **Linha 85 — `combatTurn(move)`**: calcula dano físico a partir de `taijutsu` e dano de jutsu a partir de `ninjutsu`; consulta os bônus de `clanTraits` e desconta chakra de combate.
- **Linhas 91–92 — `choose()` e `applyEffect()`**: `choose()` aplica as consequências de escolhas e avança o ano; `applyEffect()` interpreta mudanças de atributos. Pode ser relevante se desbloqueios forem concedidos por eventos.
- **Linhas 93 e 96, 99–101 — `stat()` e `render()`**: exibem atributos, recursos, atividades e controles de combate. Seriam pontos para apresentar um valor de poder ou uma lista de técnicas disponíveis.
- **Linha 89 — `continueAsChild(index)`**: inicia a jornada da próxima geração, mas não reinicializa os atributos e recursos como `intel`, `ninjutsu`, `chakra` e `chakraPoints`. Isso pode fazer a criança herdar os valores do personagem anterior.
- **Linhas 36–39 — `makeSetup()`, carregamento e `save()`**: a jornada é salva inteira em `localStorage` como `shinobi-save`. Se novos campos forem adicionados ao estado, também será necessário tratar saves antigos ao retomar a jornada.

## Sugestão de extensão

Para um **poder numérico**, eu separaria o valor calculado dos atributos persistidos — por exemplo, com uma função central que combine atributos, bônus de clã e técnicas desbloqueadas. Assim, a mesma regra pode ser usada na interface e no combate, sem manter um “poder” armazenado que fique desatualizado quando os atributos mudarem.

Para **técnicas desbloqueadas por inteligência ou afinidade**, os pontos principais seriam:

1. Criar uma lista de técnicas com requisitos e efeitos — incluindo afinidade, caso essa seja uma nova mecânica.
2. Guardar as técnicas desbloqueadas no estado do personagem e preencher o campo ao carregar saves antigos.
3. Verificar os requisitos tanto na interface quanto na lógica de combate; ocultar ou desabilitar um botão, por si só, não impede que a técnica seja chamada pela lógica.
4. Decidir explicitamente se a próxima geração herda técnicas, atributos ou nenhum dos dois.

## Riscos a considerar

- **`intel` não é atualmente requisito de técnica**: seu uso observado é como atributo de missão e como atributo que pode aumentar por estudo ou escolhas.
- **Atributos e recursos são coisas diferentes**: `chakra` aparece como atributo de progresso, enquanto `chakraPoints` é o recurso consumido no combate.
- **Limites podem ser inconsistentes**: `applyEffect()` aplica `clamp()`, mas algumas atividades e ganhos diretos de combate alteram atributos com `+=`. Um novo poder calculado pode, portanto, ultrapassar os limites que a interface aparenta impor.
- **Continuação como filho pode transferir força indevidamente**: `continueAsChild()` muda identidade, clã e vila, mas conserva boa parte do estado numérico do personagem anterior.
- **Possível lacuna no próprio arquivo**: a interface chama `doAction()` e a inicialização/progressão chama `nextEvent()`, mas não encontrei definições dessas funções no arquivo. Convém verificar esse ponto antes de escolher exatamente onde inserir a lógica de atividades ou de eventos.
</subagent>

## Objective
- Ampliar a crônica do jogo Shinobi e implementar um nível numérico de força para personagens, além de jutsus desbloqueados conforme a inteligência e a afinidade de chakra do jogador.

## Requirements
- Exibir força com valores de referência como Hashirama e Madara: 3000; Naruto criança: 700.
- Calcular a força do personagem do jogador com base em seus atributos.
- Definir afinidade de chakra pela linhagem ou aleatoriamente.
- Desbloquear jutsus conforme a inteligência e a afinidade.
- Manter registros de mudanças de atributos e relações, acontecimentos do mundo Shinobi e um elenco maior em cada era.

## Decisions
- A seção de diário chama-se “Crônica Shinobi”.
- A afinidade herdada tem 75% de chance; caso contrário, é sorteada.
- Jutsus são separados por afinidade e têm requisitos de inteligência, custo de chakra e multiplicador de dano.

## Work State
### Completed
- Elenco ampliado por era, incluindo Kiba, Ino e Shikamaru na era Naruto.
- Crônica com categorias e variações de atributos e relações; registros cobrem escolhas, eventos canônicos, atividades, interações, família e combate.
- Implementada em `index.html` uma tabela de força para personagens, cálculo `powerLevel()`, afinidades de chakra por clã, catálogo de jutsus por afinidade e desbloqueios por inteligência.
- Combate passou a permitir selecionar jutsus desbloqueados, com custo e dano ajustados pela técnica.
- Afinidade e técnicas conhecidas são inicializadas ao criar ou retomar uma jornada.

### Active
- Integrar `powerLevel()` e `renderJutsuPanel()` à interface; ambos existem, mas ainda não são exibidos.
- Validar sintaxe, interface, salvamento/retomada e desbloqueios de jutsus; as alterações recentes ainda não foram testadas.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Exibir a força numérica do jogador e os valores de referência dos personagens na interface, além do painel de afinidade e jutsus.
2. Verificar os fluxos de desbloqueio, seleção de técnicas em combate e compatibilidade com jornadas salvas.
3. Executar verificações de sintaxe e testes disponíveis; revisar alterações não commitadas.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: interface e lógica do jogo, elenco, crônica, força, afinidades e jutsus.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: testes de fluxo existentes; inclui expectativa para o título “Crônica Shinobi”.
- `/tmp/opencode/shinobi-check.js`: script usado para verificar sintaxe do JavaScript extraído.

## Important Context
- Alterações do projeto ainda não foram commitadas; os arquivos aparecem como não rastreados.

All relevant game logic is in [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html); no files were changed.

- **Village-specific clans:** Clan and village options, plus clan traits, are global constants near lines **14–29**. `makeSetup()` (**53**) generates the setup UI; `startGame()` (**55**) initializes the character and applies starting bonuses. These are the main places to connect clan availability to village choice.
- **Lineage- and stat-gated techniques:** Affinity techniques are in `jutsusByAffinity` (**30–38**), with intelligence-based unlocks in `unlockedJutsus()` (**48**) and display in `renderJutsuPanel()` (**50**). Add clan techniques to the data/unlock flow, then integrate them into `combatTurn()` (**102**) for use in battle. Lineage state is tracked through `state.lineage` and `state.children`; `relationshipAction()` (**104**) creates children and `continueAsChild()` (**106**) switches to a child.
- **Roster power labels:** `availableCharacters()` (**45**) assembles roster entries and attaches values from `characterPower` (**39**). `renderRelations()` (**111**) displays relation details but does not currently show `person.power`, making it the likely display change point.

- **Combat strength:** `powerLevel()` (**47**) calculates player power. `render()` (**118**) shows that value and fixed comparisons for Hashirama, Madara, and Naruto’s child. Combat opponent stats are generated in `startCombat()` (**101**) using a flat age-based value (`9 + floor(age/5)`); `characterPower` currently populates roster records, not combat opponents.

- Show Hashirama and Madara at 3000 power and child Naruto at 700.

Vitalidade recuperada até 12.';}}}addJournal(text,'Combate');save();render();toast(text);}function setRogue(){if(state.rogue)return;state.rogue=true;state.bond=clamp(state.bond-8);state.renown+=2;addJournal(`Você abandonou ${state.village} e passou a viver como ninja rogue (nukenin).`);save();}function becomeRogue(){if(state.rogue)return;if(confirm(`Abandonar ${state.village} e se tornar um ninja rogue (nukenin)? messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the Shinobi game’s chronicle, power levels, and affinity-based jutsu progression.
- Add village-specific clans and lineage/stat-gated clan techniques, show character combat power, provide a dedicated battle screen, balance character strengths, and allow families through strong relationships.

## Requirements
- Hashirama and Madara should be around 3,000 power, with Madara stronger than Kakashi; child Naruto should be around 700.
- Calculate player power from attributes; determine chakra affinity through lineage or random selection.
- Unlock affinity and clan techniques using their required attributes and lineage; apply chakra costs and technique-specific damage.
- Show combat power beside character names; render combat as its own screen.
- Village selection should constrain available clans; characters should have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children with a character after reaching a sufficient relationship level.
- Maintain the “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.

## Decisions
- Inherited chakra affinity has a 75% chance; otherwise affinity is random.
- Clan techniques require the player’s clan lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Added village-clan associations and themed clan techniques in `index.html`; existing family eligibility is age 18+ and bond score 40+.

## Work State
### Completed
- Prior work expanded the cast and chronicle, implemented attribute-based power, affinity jutsu, combat costs/damage, save/resume initialization, and related interface panels.
- Added village-specific clan data, clan traits and affinity mappings for additional clans, plus stat-gated clan technique definitions and lineage-aware unlock helpers.
- Added CSS for a standalone battle-screen layout.

### Active
- Finish village-filtered clan selection integration and validate it.
- Add clan techniques to the battle selector/combat execution, and complete the standalone battle-screen rendering.
- Display power beside character names and rebalance character power references, including Madara above Kakashi.
- Verify family/child flows and all updated game behavior; run syntax and gameplay tests.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect current `index.html` edits for consistency and JavaScript syntax, correcting any issues.
2. Complete clan technique combat integration and conditional battle-only rendering.
3. Add power labels to character roster names and adjust character power values.
4. Run existing JavaScript syntax, save/resume, combat, and relationship tests.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, village/clan setup, lineage and jutsu logic, character power data, combat and family systems.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were previously reported as untracked.
- Existing family flow requires age 18 and relationship value ≥40, prompts for a child’s name, and supports continuing as a child at age 16.
- Previous validation scripts were `/tmp/opencode/shinobi-check.js` and `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`; direct check script previously failed with `ReferenceError: localStorage is not defined`, while independent syntax and gameplay tests passed.

## Objective
- Complete the Shinobi game’s chronicle, character progression, village/clan choices, combat, and family systems in `index.html`.

- Set Hashirama near 3,000 power, Madara stronger than Kakashi and near 3,000, and child Naruto near 700.

## Objective
- Complete and review the Shinobi game’s chronicle, progression, village/clan choices, combat, and family systems in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Set Hashirama near 3,000 power, Madara stronger than Kakashi and near 3,000, and child Naruto near 700.
- Calculate player power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Village selection constrains clans; characters have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children after reaching sufficient relationship level.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Family eligibility requires age 18+ and relationship score 40+.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded the cast and chronicle; implemented attribute-based player power, affinity and clan jutsu, save/resume initialization, village-filtered clan selection, family progression, and lineage-aware technique discovery.
- Set Madara to 3,200, Hashirama to 3,000, and child Naruto to 700; added power labels to relationship roster entries.
- Added a standalone battle screen, opponent power, technique selection, chakra costs, turn logging, jutsu execution, combat save/resume, and calibrated opponent damage.
- Gameplay and combat test harnesses pass: `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs` and `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`.

### Active
- Review remaining progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`; rerun the inline JavaScript syntax check.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Continue reviewing progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`.
2. Run both test harnesses and validate inline JavaScript syntax using a temporary file; the process-substitution syntax check failed with `ENOENT` for `/proc/.../fd/pipe:[...]`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Gameplay test harness for timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat-focused harness, including affinity inheritance, combat save/resume, and fleeing.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- The combat test’s power assertion expects localized formatting via `toLocaleString('pt-BR')`.
- `characterPower.Madara` is `3200`; the stats-panel reference displays `3.200`.

## Objective
- Complete and review the Shinobi game’s chronicle, progression, village/clan choices, combat, and family systems in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Set Hashirama near 3,000 power, Madara stronger than Kakashi and near 3,000, and child Naruto near 700.
- Calculate player power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Village selection constrains clans; characters have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children after reaching sufficient relationship level.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Family eligibility requires age 18+ and relationship score 40+.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded the cast and chronicle; implemented attribute-based player power, affinity and clan jutsu, save/resume initialization, village-filtered clan selection, family progression, and lineage-aware technique discovery.
- Set Madara to 3,200, Hashirama to 3,000, and child Naruto to 700; added power labels to relationship roster entries.
- Added a standalone battle screen, opponent power, technique selection, chakra costs, turn logging, jutsu execution, combat save/resume, and fleeing.
- Gameplay and combat tests passed; inline JavaScript syntax check passed.

### Active
- Review remaining progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`; no changes made in the latest review.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue reviewing progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`.
2. After any changes, rerun `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs` and `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`.
3. Recheck inline JavaScript syntax if changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Gameplay test harness for timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat-focused harness, including affinity inheritance, combat save/resume, and fleeing.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- The combat test’s power assertion expects localized formatting via `toLocaleString('pt-BR')`; `characterPower.Madara` is `3200`, and the stats-panel reference displays `3.200`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and review the Shinobi game’s chronicle, progression, village/clan choices, combat, and family systems in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Set Hashirama near 3,000 power, Madara stronger than Kakashi and near 3,000, and child Naruto near 700.
- Calculate player power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Village selection constrains clans; characters have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children after reaching sufficient relationship level.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Family eligibility requires age 18+ and relationship score 40+.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded the cast and chronicle; implemented attribute-based player power, affinity and clan jutsu, save/resume initialization, village-filtered clan selection, family progression, and lineage-aware technique discovery.
- Set Madara to 3,200, Hashirama to 3,000, and child Naruto to 700; added power labels to relationship roster entries.
- Added a standalone battle screen, opponent power, technique selection, chakra costs, turn logging, jutsu execution, and fleeing.
- Escaped player village, clan, name, and avatar initial in the main game header/profile to prevent HTML injection.
- Gameplay and combat harnesses pass; inline JavaScript syntax check passes.

### Active
- Review remaining progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue reviewing progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`, especially inconsistent input escaping in rendered content and combat-selection behavior.
2. After changes, run `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs` and `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`.
3. Recheck inline JavaScript syntax by extracting the script to a regular temporary file, then running `node --check` on it.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Gameplay test harness for timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat-focused harness, including affinity inheritance, combat save/resume, and fleeing.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Combat harness power assertion expects localized formatting via `toLocaleString('pt-BR')`; `characterPower.Madara` is `3200`, displayed as `3.200`.

## Objective

- Add parent-derived clan lineage, optional yearly choices, randomized lifespan, civilian marriage, and progressive Sharingan abilities.

## Requirements
- Calculate player power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Village selection constrains clans; characters have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children after reaching sufficient relationship level.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.
- Children inherit both parents’ lineages; a civilian spouse contributes no lineage, while the player’s lineage is passed on.
- Make yearly story choices optional rather than required to advance the year.
- Give each character a random lifespan between 80 and 100 years.
- Support Sharingan progression through 1, 2, and 3 tomoe, then Mangekyō; each stage grants stats, and Mangekyō grants special abilities.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Family eligibility requires age 18+ and relationship score 40+.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and review the Shinobi game in `index.html`, including chronicle, progression, combat, and family systems.
- Finish dual-parent lineage, optional year advancement, randomized lifespan, and progressive Sharingan abilities.

## Requirements
- Calculate player power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Village selection constrains clans; characters have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children after reaching sufficient relationship level.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.
- Children inherit both parents’ lineages; civilian spouses contribute no lineage, while the player’s lineage is passed on.
- Make yearly story choices optional rather than required to advance the year.
- Give each character a random lifespan between 80 and 100 years.
- Support Sharingan progression through 1, 2, and 3 tomoe, then Mangekyō; each stage grants stats, and Mangekyō grants special abilities.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Family eligibility requires age 18+ and relationship score 40+.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded the cast and chronicle; implemented attribute-based player power, affinity and clan jutsu, save/resume initialization, village-filtered clan selection, family progression, and lineage-aware technique discovery.
- Set Madara to 3,200, Hashirama to 3,000, and child Naruto to 700; added power labels to relationship roster entries.
- Added a standalone battle screen, opponent power, technique selection, chakra costs, turn logging, jutsu execution, and fleeing.
- Escaped user-provided values in rendered content and handled malformed saved JSON in setup initialization.
- Updated `powerLevel()` to sum clamped attributes; added `randomLifespan()`, lineage helpers, and Sharingan stage/trait helpers.
- Child creation now assembles lineage from both parents, uses spouse clan metadata when present, and assigns a randomized lifespan; succession reads the child’s lineage and lifespan.
- Inspected year advancement, combat, and rendering paths; confirmed the remaining gaps below.

### Active
- Make story choices optional for advancing the year; call Sharingan progression during year advancement and end lives at `state.lifespan`.
- Connect `activeClanTraits()` to combat and cost calculations; show Sharingan stage and Mangekyō abilities in the UI.
- Review progression, combat, and rendered-content edge cases, then validate.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `choose(i)`/year advancement to support skipping the story choice, progress Sharingan, initialize `state.lifespan` for new lives, and finish at the lifespan rather than hard-coded age 85.
2. Use `activeClanTraits()` in combat, jutsu cost calculations, and UI; expose Sharingan stage and Mangekyō abilities.
3. Run `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`, `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`, inline JavaScript syntax validation, and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation; current progression, combat, lifespan, and Sharingan gaps.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Gameplay harness for timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat harness, including affinity inheritance, combat save/resume, and fleeing.

## Important Context

- New players do not yet receive a lifespan; year advancement still ends at age 85.
- No validation has run after the latest edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and review the Shinobi game in `index.html`, including chronicle, progression, combat, and family systems.
- Finish optional year advancement, randomized lifespan, and progressive Sharingan abilities.

## Requirements
- Calculate player power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Village selection constrains clans; characters have techniques associated with their clan.
- Enable having children after reaching sufficient relationship level.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with changes, world events, and a larger cast across eras.
- Children inherit both parents’ lineages; civilian spouses contribute no lineage, while the player’s lineage is passed on.
- Make yearly story choices optional rather than required to advance the year.
- Give each character a random lifespan between 80 and 100 years.
- Support Sharingan progression through 1, 2, and 3 tomoe, then Mangekyō; each stage grants stats, and Mangekyō grants special abilities.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Family eligibility requires age 18+ and relationship score 40+.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded the cast and chronicle; implemented attribute-based player power, affinity and clan jutsu, save/resume initialization, village-filtered clan selection, family progression, and lineage-aware technique discovery.
- Added a standalone battle screen, opponent power, technique selection, chakra costs, turn logging, jutsu execution, and fleeing.
- Added escaped rendering of user-provided values and handling for malformed saved JSON.
- Added lineage helpers, randomized lifespan and affinity helpers, and Sharingan stage/trait helpers.
- Child creation assembles lineage from both parents, uses spouse clan metadata when present, and assigns a randomized lifespan; succession reads the child’s lineage and lifespan.

### Active
- Integrate optional story-choice skipping into year advancement; advance Sharingan each year; initialize lifespan for new lives and older saves; end each life at its assigned lifespan.
- Use `activeClanTraits()` in combat, jutsu cost calculations, and UI; display Sharingan stage and Mangekyō abilities.
- Review progression, combat, and rendering edge cases, then validate.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a shared year-advance path so `choose(i)` applies an optional story choice and a separate skip action advances without one; reset activities, progress Sharingan, and end life at `state.lifespan`.
2. Initialize `state.lifespan` in `startGame()` and when resuming older saves.
3. Replace static clan trait lookups in combat, technique cost/UI with `activeClanTraits()`; display Sharingan stage and Mangekyō abilities.
4. Run `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`, `node /tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`, inline JavaScript syntax validation, and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation; remaining progression, combat, lifespan, and Sharingan work.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume test harness.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat, affinity inheritance, save/resume, and fleeing test harness.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked (`git status --short` showed `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`).
- `choose(i)` is currently the only year-advancement path; `skipActivities()` only displays a toast.
- `startGame()` does not set a lifespan; `choose(i)` still ends at age 85.
- `awakenSharingan()` currently runs only during child succession; combat and jutsu costs still use static `clanTraits`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the Shinobi game in `index.html`, including chronicle, progression, combat, and family systems.

## Requirements
- Calculate power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Constrain clans by village; associate characters with clan techniques.
- Enable having children at age 18+ with relationship score 40+.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with events and characters across eras.
- Children inherit both parents’ lineages; civilian spouses add no lineage.
- Allow advancing the year without making a story choice.
- Assign each character a random lifespan of 80–100 years.
- Progress Sharingan through 1, 2, and 3 tomoe, then Mangekyō; grant stats at each stage and special abilities at Mangekyō.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added optional year advancement via `advanceYear()` and `skipActivities()`.
- Added Sharingan progression, combat traits, inherited Uchiha lineage support, and stage display.
- Added random lifespans for new games and legacy saves; reaching the lifespan ends the character’s life.
- Integrated active clan traits with combat, technique costs, and UI.
- Added lifespan display and “Avançar sem escolher” control.
- Timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume checks pass with lineage assertions updated for multi-parent ancestry.
- Combat, affinity inheritance, battle screen, save/resume, and fleeing checks pass with the same assertion adjustment.
- Inline JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Review final changes and remaining progression/combat edge cases.

### Blocked
- The original `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs` fail on `save snapshot failed` because their assertions expect exactly one lineage entry; temporary adjusted copies pass when the outdated single-entry expectation is relaxed.

## Next Move
1. Review the final diff and remaining progression/combat edge cases.
2. Consider updating the external test assertions to account for inherited lineage from both parents.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation and uncommitted changes.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat, affinity inheritance, save/resume, and fleeing checks.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and currently reported as untracked: `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- Temporary passing test copies are `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-updated.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat-updated.cjs`; they relax the lineage-count assertions.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the Shinobi game in `index.html`, including chronicle, progression, combat, and family systems.

## Requirements
- Calculate power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Constrain clans by village and associate characters with clan techniques.
- Enable having children at age 18+ with relationship score 40+.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with events and characters across eras.
- Children inherit both parents’ lineages; civilian spouses add no lineage.
- Allow advancing the year without making a story choice.
- Assign each character a random lifespan of 80–100 years.
- Progress Sharingan through 1, 2, and 3 tomoe, then Mangekyō; grant stats at each stage and special abilities at Mangekyō.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented optional year advancement, Sharingan progression, random lifespans, clan traits and techniques, combat display, lineage inheritance, and related UI.
- Timeline, character availability, family creation, succession, rendering, save/resume, combat, affinity inheritance, and fleeing checks pass with lineage assertions relaxed for multi-parent ancestry.
- Inline JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Review final changes and remaining progression/combat edge cases.

### Blocked
- Original `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs` fail at `save snapshot failed` because they expect exactly one lineage entry; adjusted copies pass with assertions accepting multiple lineage entries.

## Next Move
1. Review `index.html` for remaining progression/combat edge cases.
2. Consider updating the external test assertions to account for inherited lineage from both parents.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation; changes remain uncommitted.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat, affinity inheritance, save/resume, and fleeing checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-updated.cjs`: Passing adjusted timeline/family test copy.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat-updated.cjs`: Passing adjusted combat test copy.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and currently reported as untracked: `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- Adjusted test copies relax the outdated single-lineage expectation; they pass with the current multi-parent ancestry behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the Shinobi game in `index.html`, including chronicle, progression, combat, and family systems.

## Requirements
- Calculate power from attributes; inherit chakra affinity 75% of the time, otherwise choose randomly.
- Gate clan techniques on lineage and technique-specific attributes; apply chakra costs and technique damage.
- Show combat power beside character names and render battles as a dedicated screen.
- Constrain clans by village and associate characters with clan techniques.
- Enable having children at age 18+ with relationship score 40+.
- Expand “Crônica Shinobi” with events and characters across eras.
- Children inherit both parents’ lineages; civilian spouses add no lineage.
- Allow advancing the year without making a story choice.
- Assign each character a random lifespan of 80–100 years.
- Progress Sharingan through 1, 2, and 3 tomoe, then Mangekyō; grant stats at each stage and special abilities at Mangekyō.

## Decisions
- Clan techniques require lineage and technique-specific stat thresholds.
- Village-to-clan associations and themed techniques are defined in `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented optional year advancement, Sharingan progression, random lifespans, clan traits and techniques, combat display, lineage inheritance, and related UI.
- Adjusted timeline/family and combat tests pass when lineage assertions accept multiple ancestors.
- Inline JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Review remaining progression and combat edge cases in `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Original `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs` fail at `save snapshot failed` because they expect exactly one lineage entry; adjusted test copies pass with multi-parent lineage assertions.

## Next Move
1. Review remaining progression and combat edge cases, including Uchiha trait behavior before Sharingan awakening.
2. Consider updating external test assertions to account for inherited lineage from both parents.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation; changes remain uncommitted.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi.cjs`: Timeline, family, succession, rendering, and save/resume checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat.cjs`: Combat, affinity inheritance, save/resume, and fleeing checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-updated.cjs`: Passing adjusted timeline/family test copy.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-shinobi-combat-updated.cjs`: Passing adjusted combat test copy.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and currently reported as untracked: `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- Current review found `activeClanTraits()` removes Uchiha’s base combat bonuses and uses Sharingan-stage bonuses instead; stage 0 therefore has no Uchiha combat bonuses.
